clue.text: Ground mace regularly showing up to some extent

clue.text: Only one name in match notice for Greeks

explanation.definitionFit: An example: Thebans were the citizens of Thebes, the ancient city-state of Boeotia in central Greece.

clue.text: Grave message beginning to stimulate tears

clue.text: No credit for nuts in bread

clue.text: Love children leading in British publicity

clue.text: Sonny perhaps at home in large car
